summary: Tested frontend only (local-only Expo app, no backend) at 390x844 via Playwright. All requested features PASS. (1) Neck: 11 slide thumbnails render (section-neck-s2-image-0 ... s18-image-0); tapping opens slide-viewer with caption; open-image-quiz-button -> /quiz/neck?mode=image&count=11, counter 1/11, quiz-question-image renders. (2) Textbook review: all 14 topics show 'All 30 chapter questions', navigate to ?mode=book&count=30, counter 1/30, quiz-source-textbook tag shown; full 30-question Neck run finished, button then shows 'Best 10/30'; one 2-option question seen (expected). validate_data.js: 420 questions, 0 issues. (3) Weak spots: with no misses, Home shows 'Questions you miss will appear here' and the button is aria-disabled and does nothing on tap; same for the topic button ('No missed questions'). After 5 wrong answers in a Liver quiz, localStorage holds 5 missed IDs, topic-missed-count reads '5 missed to retry' and home-missed-count reads 'Retry 5 questions you missed', and both still show after a reload. The Home weak quiz had 5/5 questions, all previously missed. Answering 4 correctly dropped the count to 1 on Home and on the topic, and the topic weak review then showed 1/1. Missed image-quiz questions are included too (Neck: 20 textbook + 9 image = 29 counted, quiz 1/29 with image). Counts update after in-app back navigation without a reload. Visiting the empty weak URL directly shows the quiz-empty message. (4) The Progress tab recent list shows 'Weak spot review (5)', 'The Neck · Textbook' and 'The Neck · Image quiz'. (5) Regression PASS: search 'thyroid' (32 results incl. Neck notes), theme toggle (light<->dark), mock exam (10 Q from 13 chapters), flashcards flip/known/bookmark, section + card bookmarks on the Saved tab. No page errors. No deprecated Expo packages found.

ui_bugs.issue: Topic-scoped weak review (and empty state) shows subtitle '1 CHAPTERS' (wrong plural). For a single topic, show the topic title instead. Reference: app/quiz/[id].tsx:37

issues: Distractors come from all chapters' captions (e.g. 'Normal spleen' and 'Testicular torsion' offered for a thyroid image), so many questions are trivially easy. Prefer distractors from the same topic first (src/data/quiz.ts:23).
A square black focus outline is drawn inside the rounded search field when it is focused (web only). Minor.

action_items: LOW: In quiz/[id].tsx, make the subtitle singular-aware: use the topic title when config.topicIds.length === 1, otherwise 'N chapters'.

LOW: missedCount() counts raw stored keys by ID prefix, but weakQuestions() only returns IDs that still exist. Stale IDs (an image key later added to EXCLUDE, or renumbered book questions) would show a count that is larger than the quiz, or enable the button for an empty quiz. Compute the count with weakQuestions(topicIds, missed).length, or prune unknown IDs on load.
LOW: The Home weak-spot quiz is capped at 50 questions, but the label says 'Retry N questions' even when N > 50. Either mention the cap or remove it.
LOW: Image quiz distractors should come from the same topic first, so questions are harder.
LOW: Remove the duplicate useProgress() call in quiz/[id].tsx (lines 38 and 42).
critical_code_review_comments: quiz/[id].tsx calls useProgress() twice (progressState/markAnswer and state/recordQuiz). This is redundant.
missedCount (src/data/quiz.ts:49) is not derived from the real question pool, so it can drift out of sync with weakQuestions.
markAnswer runs on every submit in all modes (mixed, image, book, mock, weak). This is intended and works.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests cleared localStorage before each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Local-only app. Progress is in localStorage key 'sono_study_progress_v1' (the value may be double-JSON-encoded). Missed question IDs are stored in state.missed: written '{topic}-q{n}', textbook '{topic}-b{n}', image '{topic}-iq-{key}'. Weak route: /quiz/weak?topics=a,b&count=N&mode=weak. Book route: /quiz/{id}?mode=book&count=30. Neck has 11 quizzable images. In the mock setup all chapters are preselected, so mock-select-all-button deselects them all.
